title: Aerial Targeting Assist (lead indicators, gentle magnetism, altitude nudge)
description:
Purpose: Improve aerial combat feel in hover/flight: predictive lead indicators, gentle reticle magnetism, optional altitude nudge via Right Stick up/down in assist mode, and reticle stabilization against head bob. Toggle in Wrist Menu.

Controls (Quest 3 — verbatim):
- Left Trigger: momentary lock refines target.
- Right Thumbstick up/down: altitude nudges when in assist mode (flight/hover already integrate altitude; this adds finer stepping for aim assist context).

Params (params_json):
- enable (bool, default true)
- lead_stiffness (float, default 0.6)
- magnetism_cone_deg (float, default 5.0)
- magnetism_strength (float, default 0.15)
- altitude_nudge_step_m (float, default 0.2)

Behaviour:
1) Compute predicted intercept points for current target velocity; draw a lead reticle (ring_hud_ui_pack style) in world.
2) Apply a small aim magnetism within cone to nudge projectile spawn direction; never overpowers player input.
3) While enabled, Right Stick vertical micro-nudges altitude by step amount for fine-lined shots.
4) Reticle stabilization: smooths reticle presentation against head bob by low-pass filtering aim anchor.

Components:
- Reads: target velocities, player aim, CInput, CComfortState, flight/hover mode.
- Writes: CHUDIndicators (lead brackets), CAimAssist parameters.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_aerial_assist_lead: lead indicator appears; slight offsets still connect.

Integration and depends_on:
- Adds a toggle under Wrist Menu Settings > Combat. Depends on hud_and_wrist_menu for UI page.

Scenes:
- open_orbital_battlefield, zero_g_flight_gauntlet.

Suggested file split: aerial_assist_register.cpp, aerial_assist_compute.cpp, aerial_assist_ui.cpp.
